description: Calculate a real natal (birth) chart from a birth date, optional birth time and a city. Returns the Sun, Moon and rising signs, every planet with sign, degree and house, the five tightest aspects, an element and modality summary, and a link to the free full chart with the wheel on lunonis.com. Calculated in-house with an ephemeris (tropical zodiac, Placidus houses); nothing is stored. If the city name matches several places it returns status "ambiguous_place" with candidates: ask the user which one, then call again with that id as place.

lang.description: Language of the returned links (site language code). Default en.

place.description: Birth city name (e.g. "Lviv" or "Lviv, Ukraine"), or a place id from search_places. A name shared by several cities returns candidates to choose from.

time.description: Birth time, 24-hour HH:MM local time. Omit if unknown: the rising sign and houses are then left out, never guessed.

name: natal_chart
title: Natal chart
